domains.title: Education and Learning
domains.brief: Formal education and structured learning across courses, assignments, examinations, research, laboratories, academic services, credentials, and school administration. Exclude employer-owned deliverables and leisure activities without a structured learning goal.

domains.title: Work and Professional Life
domains.brief: Employment, professional practice, and business operations across projects, meetings, deliverables, clients, collaboration, workplace administration, training, and career development. Exclude school coursework, household management, and purely personal finance.

domains.title: Home and Household Management
domains.brief: Operation of a residence and its physical household systems across maintenance, utilities, supplies, chores, security, moves, service providers, and property records. Exclude caregiving relationships and decisions whose primary goal is financial management.

domains.title: Family and Caregiving Life
domains.brief: Relationships and practical support within families and caregiving networks across dependents, appointments, shared plans, communication, celebrations, and responsibilities. Exclude residence maintenance and clinical treatment decisions.

domains.title: Health and Wellbeing
domains.brief: Personal health maintenance and everyday wellbeing across appointments, records, fitness, nutrition, accessibility, routines, supplies, and following saved professional guidance. Exclude diagnosis, treatment selection, dosage changes, and emergency decisions.

domains.title: Travel and Mobility
domains.brief: Movement of people across commuting, local transportation, multi-stop travel, reservations, itineraries, travel documents, accessibility, packing, and disruptions. Exclude vehicle or property tasks when no trip or mobility goal is involved.

domains.title: Personal Finance and Consumer Life
domains.brief: Personal money and consumer decisions across budgets, accounts, bills, payments, insurance administration, purchases, subscriptions, refunds, warranties, and financial records. Exclude business finance, professional tax or legal advice, investment trading, and other high-stakes financial decisions.

domains.title: Community and Civic Life
domains.brief: Participation in formal communities and public institutions across volunteering, libraries, neighborhood groups, local programs, public services, memberships, shared resources, and civic administration. Exclude private friend-group coordination, political persuasion, and legal interpretation.

domains.title: Social and Cultural Life
domains.brief: Interpersonal relationships and cultural participation across friendships, invitations, gatherings, celebrations, performances, exhibitions, cultural groups, and shared social commitments. Exclude formal civic administration and activities primarily organized around skill practice or competition.

domains.title: Recreation, Sports, and Hobbies
domains.brief: Leisure activities pursued primarily for play, practice, mastery, or competition across sports, outdoor activities, games, crafts, collections, equipment, clubs, events, and hobby communities. Exclude formal coursework and gatherings whose primary purpose is social or cultural attendance.
